// Function to convert Dec from decimal degrees to +DD:MM:SS.S format

  degrees = int(v: dec)
  minutes_decimal = math.abs(x: (float(v: dec) - float(v: degrees)) * 60.0)
  minutes = int(v: minutes_decimal)
  minutes_str = if minutes < 10 then "0" + string(v: minutes) else string(v: minutes)  // Add leading zero if minutes < 10
  seconds = (minutes_decimal - float(v: minutes)) * 60.0
  seconds_str = if seconds < 10.0 then "0" + string(v: math.round(x: seconds * 10.0) / 10.0) else string(v: math.round(x: seconds * 10.0) / 10.0)  // Add leading zero if seconds < 10
  sign = if dec < 0.0 then "-" else "+"
  return sign + string(v: math.abs(x: float(v: degrees))) + ":" + minutes_str + ":" + seconds_str
}

// Map over the data to include raw and formatted Dec
data
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    raw_Dec_degrees: r._value,  // Raw Dec in degrees

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTM2.logevent_closedLoopControlMode" and r["_field"] == "mode")
  |> last() // Get the most recent mode
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    description: 
      if r._value == 1.00 then "Idle"
      else if r._value == 2.00 then "TELEMETRY ONLY"
      else if r._value == 3.00 then "OPEN LOOP"
      else if r._value == 4.00 then "CLOSED LOOP"
      else "UNKNOWN"
    }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "description"])

queries.query:
from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -7d) // Large range to ensure the most recent record is found
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTM1M3.logevent_slewControllerSettings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "useVelocityForces" or 
                       r["_field"] == "useBalanceForces" or 
                       r["_field"] == "useAccelerationForces" or 
                       r["_field"] == "triggerBoosterValves")
  |> last() // Fetch the most recent record for each field
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    useVelocityForces: if r.useVelocityForces == true then "TRUE" else "FALSE",
    useBalanceForces: if r.useBalanceForces == true then "TRUE" else "FALSE",
    useAccelerationForces: if r.useAccelerationForces == true then "TRUE" else "FALSE",
    triggerBoosterValves: if r.triggerBoosterValves == true then "TRUE" else "FALSE"
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "useVelocityForces", "useBalanceForces", "useAccelerationForces", "triggerBoosterValves"])
